findings.title: Next 16 needs data-scroll-behavior="smooth" on <html>, or route transitions scroll smoothly
findings.fix: Render <html lang="en-IN" data-scroll-behavior="smooth" suppressHydrationWarning>, and say in §4.5 that smooth scroll applies only to same-page hash jumps.

findings.title: TestimonialsCarousel has no props contract; the program label needs course data that client code may not import
findings.fix: Declare TestimonialCard {id,name,role,program,quote,rating} in testimonials.ts. The server home page maps courseSlug to shortTitle; the carousel takes { items: TestimonialCard[] } via import type only. Add a test that every courseSlug resolves, with 2 per slug.

findings.title: The marquee wrapped-row fallback CSS can't wrap a w-max row and leaves the edge mask on
findings.where: §4.5 NOSCRIPT_CSS line 5 and the reduced-motion layer 2 rule; §7.1 #2; §14 noscript-style.test
findings.fix: Pin the markup (data-marquee-track holds the mask; rows are 'animate-marquee flex w-max gap-3'; inner ul is flex-wrap). Replace the rule with .animate-marquee{animation:none!important;transform:none!important;width:auto!important;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}[data-marquee-track]{mask-image:none!important} in both places, and update the rule count to 7 and the tests.

findings.title: ui/sonner.tsx uses useTheme, so it must be a client component, but it is missing from the client list and the ESLint override list
findings.fix: Add sonner.tsx to the client list and to the no-restricted-imports override files.

findings.title: MobileEnrolBar props are undefined
findings.fix: Props { feeLabel: string; href: `/contact/?course=${CourseSlug}` }, passed from the course page.

findings.title: Title and description copy for /, /courses/, /about/ and /contact/ is not given
findings.fix: Pin titles 'Programs', 'About Us', 'Contact & Enquiries' plus the home absolute title; put descriptions (70–160 chars) in site.ts pageMeta.

findings.title: Aurora overflow clipping is unspecified; a global overflow-x-hidden would break the sticky EnrolCard
findings.fix: The AuroraBackground wrapper is absolute inset-0 -z-10 overflow-hidden inside a relative isolate section. Never set overflow hidden on html/body/main; use overflow-x: clip if a global guard is needed.

findings.title: The carousel live region announces on page load because of the initial callback invocation
findings.fix: Keep the live text in separate state, initially empty, set only from the select event; update the test.
